test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 21 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.2.
solution:
The correct answer is 'creative'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given blank needs an adjective to describe the succeeding noun form.
 
• Let us look into the type of the given options - 
 
 
• creation - noun
 
• created - past tense form of verb create
 
• creative - adjective
 
• creating - present participle form of verb create
 
 
 
• From the above it is clear that creative is the appropriate word for the given blank. 
 
• Hence, option 3 is the correct answer. 

*Correct passage - **Dance as an artistic form of (1) expression is extremely old. Evidence of dance as a (2) creative form is available in ancient literary texts, painting and sculpture. (3) Many of the dance forms trace their roots to the (4) techniques of movement codified in the Natya Shastra (5) compiled by Bharat Muni.*
